plugins.name: Guide Titles
plugins.description: Rewrites programme titles in the guide by rule after each EPG refresh: moves the matchup into the title when the source puts only the sport there, turns "at" into "vs" and adds a sport emoji. Edits the source's own programmes in place and keeps the originals, so channels stay mapped to the real source and a rule that stops working leaves plain titles, never an empty guide.
plugins.author: johnschult

plugins.name: Recording Piggyback
plugins.description: While a channel is recording, in Dispatcharr's DVR or by Sportarr, other channels carrying the same provider stream play through the recording's connection instead of opening another one, and the recorded program gets a mark in the guide.
plugins.author: johnschult

plugins.name: VOD Category Tidy
plugins.description: Cleans up movie and series categories for Xtream Codes apps: strips prefixes like "Movie-" and "Series-" and merges overlapping categories, and hides categories by word. Only what apps see changes; Dispatcharr keeps the provider's categories, so refreshes are unaffected.
plugins.author: johnschult
